ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: \[ \left[\begin{array}{l} \dot{x}_1 \\ \dot{x}_2 \end{array}\right]=\left[\begin{array}{cc} -2 & k \\ 1 & 0 \end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{l} x_1 \\ x_2 \end{array}\right]+\left[\begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 1 \end{array}\right] u, y=\left[\begin{array}{ll} 1 & 0 \end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{l} x_1 \\ x_2 \end{array}\right] \]
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: There are two dynamic links in the figure. The upper dynamic block is labeled 1/(s+2), its output line is labeled x1, and this output is the Y(s) on the right, so y = x1. The lower dynamic block is labeled 1/s, and its output is labeled x2. The upper summing point receives the input u from the left, and receives the signal fed back upward from x2 after passing through the gain k; both inputs have positive signs. The lower summing point on the right receives the signal coming down from y = x1 and the signal branched from the input u on the left; both inputs also have positive signs, and then enter the integrator 1/s. Then reason: The input of the upper 1/(s+2) block is v = u + kx2. Because 1/(s+2) represents the relation X1(s)/V(s)=1/(s+2), in the time domain there is x1_dot + 2x1 = v, therefore x1_dot = -2x1 + u + kx2. The input of the lower integrator 1/s is w = y + u = x1 + u, and the integrator output is x2, so x2_dot = w = x1 + u. The output is y = x1. Therefore, collecting coefficients according to the state vector [x1, x2]^T, obtain A = [[-2, k], [1, 0]], B = [[1], [1]], C = [1, 0], D = 0.

raw_record.question_text: Given the block diagram of a system as shown in the image, determine the state-space representation of the system according to the state variables specified in the diagram.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the two dynamic blocks and their state labels, noting that the output of 1/(s+2) is x1 and also y, while the output of 1/s is x2. Then write the signal entering the upper block as v = u + kx2 from the top summing junction. Apply the first-order block relation to get x1_dot = -2x1 + u + kx2. Next read the lower summing junction: it adds y = x1 and u before the integrator, so w = x1 + u and therefore x2_dot = x1 + u. Finally collect coefficients to form A = [[-2,k],[1,0]], B = [[1],[1]], C = [1,0], D = 0.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中有两个动态环节。上方动态块标为 1/(s+2)，其输出线上标注为 x1，并且该输出就是右侧的 Y(s)，所以 y = x1。下方动态块标为 1/s，其输出标注为 x2。上方求和点接收左侧输入 u，并接收由 x2 经过增益 k 后反馈上来的信号，两个输入均为正号。右侧下方求和点接收从 y = x1 向下来的信号和从左侧输入 u 分支来的信号，两个输入也均为正号，然后进入积分器 1/s。

再推理：上方 1/(s+2) 块的输入为 v = u + kx2。因为 1/(s+2) 表示关系 X1(s)/V(s)=1/(s+2)，所以时域中有 x1_dot + 2x1 = v，因此 x1_dot = -2x1 + u + kx2。下方积分器 1/s 的输入为 w = y + u = x1 + u，积分器输出为 x2，所以 x2_dot = w = x1 + u。输出为 y = x1。因此按状态向量 [x1, x2]^T 收集系数，得到 A = [[-2, k], [1, 0]]，B = [[1], [1]]，C = [1, 0]，D = 0。
